analysis_type: Prospective 8-per-dimension whitened-cover diagnostic against frozen 1,2,4 grids, with incremental width ratios, plateau inventory and feasible/outer vertex witnesses; no convergence, exact-global-optimum or fold-5 finite-bound claim

receipt_gate.stage58: Require status=passed, summarySha256 matching the frozen whitened result, primary_grid=4, all 5460 cells evaluated, zero unresolved cells and 200 valid transform witnesses
receipt_gate.historical_grids: Use the stored 1,2,4 grid results only as historical references; do not recompute or rewrite them
receipt_gate.fold_order: Require identical fold ids and available x positions in native and stage-58 records
receipt_gate.mismatch_policy: Stop before grid-8 evaluation if a source hash, receipt, fold order, x inventory or historical grid structure differs

grid8_rule.whitening: Reuse the exact symmetric Cholesky transform and radius 4 from stage 58; C_s=(C+C^T)/2=L*L^T, u=L^-1*delta and theta=theta_center+L*u
grid8_rule.whitened_box: Partition [-4,4]^4 into eight equal intervals per coordinate with the stage-58 outward-rounded endpoints
grid8_rule.outside_rule: Discard only when minimum_norm_squared exceeds r^2+1e-12*(1+r^2); preserve every boundary-uncertain cell
grid8_rule.outside_count_reason: The frozen grid-8 boundaries have minimum cell-wise norm at most r after the boundary tolerance, so outside_cell_count=0
grid8_rule.denominator_rule: Evaluate only cells whose denominator interval has a fixed nonzero sign. Preserve a possible ball-intersecting zero-denominator cell as unresolved and make that grid-8 union unbounded
grid8_rule.native_interval: Use exact affine forms in whitened coordinates and original-model interval arithmetic; no Taylor substitution or coordinate-only candidate approximation
grid8_rule.union: For a bounded grid, take the minimum evaluated cell lower and maximum evaluated cell upper. For an unresolved grid, use union_bounded=false and null endpoints
grid8_rule.intersection: Intersect every grid-8 union with the stage-56 baseline stored in the stage-58 envelopes. Require a nonempty intersection and center containment
grid8_rule.nested_requirement: Require grid-8 unions and final intersections to remain contained in the corresponding frozen grid-4 unions and intersections up to the boundary-rounding tolerance
grid8_rule.no_winner_selection: Grid 8 is a prospective diagnostic grid, not a post-hoc optimum or a replacement for the historical primary grid

comparison_rule.additional_tightening: Count a point only when grid8_intersection_width<grid4_intersection_width beyond the frozen numerical tolerance
comparison_rule.plateau: incremental_width_ratio=1 within the frozen 1e-12 relative-plus-absolute numerical tolerance; descriptive only, not a convergence proof
comparison_rule.nested_check: Check grid8 against both the stage-56 baseline and the frozen grid-4 final intersection; the grid-4 final intersection is already contained in stage 56
comparison_rule.report: Retain evaluated, outside and unresolved cell counts, bounded status, union and intersection widths, incremental ratio, additional tightening and plateau outcomes for every available x
comparison_rule.scope: Grid-4/grid-8 ratios measure only this frozen refinement sequence. They are not an asymptotic error estimate, probability, calibrated coverage or proof of global convergence

witness_rule.selection: For each bounded grid-8 union endpoint, retain the attaining cell and evaluate all 16 whitened-cell vertices with the original native model
witness_rule.witness_cell_count: Normally two per bounded available x, one for the union minimum and one for the union maximum; if an endpoint has no evaluated cell or the union is unbounded, do not manufacture a witness
witness_rule.vertex_evaluation: For every vertex compute theta=theta_center+L*u, whitened norm, reconstructed parameters, denominator and original native prediction; record the cell interval endpoint and vertex-to-interval gap
witness_rule.feasibility: A vertex is a feasible extremum candidate only when its whitened norm is at most r within tolerance and its denominator is negative; outer-cover vertices remain witnesses but are not feasible extrema
witness_rule.unresolved: No finite vertex witness is manufactured for an unresolved denominator cell; an unbounded union remains unbounded
witness_rule.scope: Vertex witnesses explain the interval construction and shared extreme candidates; they do not prove that an outer-cover vertex belongs to the ellipsoid or that an interval endpoint is an exact nonlinear global extremum

known_answer.grid1_scope: Every vertex of [-1,1]^4 has norm 2, so all are outside the unit ball and none is a feasible extremum candidate
known_answer.grid2_scope: The 2-per-dimension grid also admits vertices with exactly one nonzero coordinate and norm 1, which can be feasible candidates if denominator and reconstruction checks pass
known_answer.crossing_control: A possible ball-intersecting cell with denominator interval containing zero remains unresolved and does not receive finite vertex witnesses

candidate_rule.source: Reuse the 160 full-covariance support candidates and 40 algebraic extremizers from stage 58
candidate_rule.transform_witnesses: Recompute every candidate's whitened norm and reconstruction with the frozen factor and require all 200 to remain valid
candidate_rule.original_model_evaluations: Evaluate all 200 candidates with the frozen native_model implementation and require negative denominator and finite prediction
candidate_rule.grid8_containment: Check every candidate prediction against the grid-8 union and final intersection for 200 checks; unbounded-union containment is explicitly not a finite-interval certificate
candidate_rule.scope: Candidates and vertex witnesses do not replace the complete cell partition or the whitening cover proof

point_and_history_rule.point_accounting: Retain 20 available observations and all five fold-5 unavailable observations. Fold 5 receives no grid-8 cells, candidates, vertex witnesses or finite residual upper bounds
point_and_history_rule.historical_preservation: Do not rewrite stage-58, its protocol or boundary amendment, stage-56, stage-57 or any earlier results
point_and_history_rule.cell_storage: Stream all 81920 cells and store only aggregate counts, endpoint-attaining cell records and their vertex witnesses; full deterministic regeneration is provided by the analysis script

numerical_rule.engine: Use 80-digit mpmath arithmetic for whitening, affine cell intervals, native predictions and reconstruction
numerical_rule.outward_rounding: Apply the stage-58 1e-24 relative margin and nextafter conversion to evaluated native bounds and intersections
numerical_rule.outside_tolerance: Use 1e-12*(1+r^2) only for outside-ball classification; never relax denominator gates
numerical_rule.plateau_tolerance: Use 1e-12 relative plus absolute tolerance only to describe equal grid-4/grid-8 widths, not to claim mathematical convergence
numerical_rule.certificate_class: Deterministic conservative grid and witness diagnostics with high-precision floating-point arithmetic; not exact rational certificates or probability

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Roszman1白化网格收敛与共享见证_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, covariance matrices, folds, historical grids or post-hoc grid selection
No treating grid-4/grid-8 comparisons as asymptotic convergence, an error bound or an exact global optimum
No calling outer-cover vertices feasible extrema without whitened-norm, reconstruction and denominator checks
No discarding unresolved cells, manufacturing finite intervals for zero denominators or hiding unbounded unions
No grid-8 cells, candidates, vertex witnesses or finite residual bounds for fold 5
No candidate-based substitute for complete cell partition and the whitening cover proof
No probability, independent-experiment or exact-rational-certificate claim
No replacement of historical baselines or duplication of all cell records in the convergence summary
